items.name: Chair Dip
items.pose: Нижняя точка: таз перед стулом, ладони на переднем крае сиденья, локти согнуты примерно до 90°. Боковой ракурс с небольшим поворотом для видимости обеих опор.
items.specific:
Primary request: illustrate Chair Dip, the bottom position of a triceps dip supported on a chair.
Exercise source: sit at the edge of a chair, put palms on the seat beside hips, move feet forward and hips off the seat, bend elbows to 90 degrees, then push back up.
Pose and camera: near side view with a small three-quarter angle so both arm supports are understandable. A simple sturdy armless chair behind the athlete. Both palms firmly rest on the front edge of its seat behind the hips. Hips are lowered outside and just in front of the seat; torso stays close to its front edge. Elbows point back and bend approximately 90 degrees, upper arms nearly horizontal and forearms nearly vertical. Legs extend diagonally forward with slight knee bend, both heels on the ground in front. The chair legs rest on the same ground plane as the athlete's feet. Show the complete chair and full body. Do not depict sitting on the chair, a squat, a bench press or floating hands.

items.name: Diamond Push-Up
items.pose: Верхняя точка упора лёжа: тело прямое, ладони вместе под грудью, большие и указательные пальцы образуют ромб. Передне-боковой ракурс немного сверху.
items.specific:
Primary request: illustrate Diamond Push-Up using the straight-arm starting position, chosen to make the distinctive diamond hand placement visible.
Exercise source: assume a push-up plank, join index fingers and thumbs under the chest to form a diamond, lower the chest toward the hands with elbows close to the body, then press up.
Pose and camera: front three-quarter view from moderately above, looking toward the athlete's head and hands, with body receding diagonally toward the feet. Entire body visible. Both palms flat on the same floor directly under the chest, very close together. The tips of the two index fingers meet and the tips of the two thumbs meet, making a small recognizable diamond opening. Show the hand arrangement clearly without enlarging hands unnaturally. Arms straight, shoulders over hands, rigid straight line from head through hips to heels, legs straight, toes on floor. Not kneeling; no wide hand placement; no excessively raised hips. No chair or other equipment.

items.name: Lunge Touch And Kick
items.pose: Верхняя точка удара вперёд: одна нога опорная, другая поднята и выпрямлена вперёд, корпус почти вертикален. Боковой ракурс. Выпад и касание пола остаются в тексте.
items.specific:
Primary request: illustrate Lunge Touch And Kick, choosing only its front-kick phase as the single characteristic frozen pose.
Exercise source: perform a deep reverse lunge and touch the rear knee to the floor, touch the floor with the hand on the front-leg side, stand up and kick forward using the leg that had stayed in place, then return to the lunge.
Pose and camera: full-body side view with a slight three-quarter turn. Athlete stands balanced on one foot, supporting leg almost straight with a soft knee. The other leg is lifted and extended forward in a controlled front kick near hip height, toes toward the ceiling, heel leading. Torso upright with only a slight backward lean; arms naturally bent for balance. Only one foot touches the ground. Keep both legs and both arms clearly distinct and anatomically coherent. There is no floor-touching hand in this kick phase. No equipment. Do not attempt to combine the lunge, floor touch and kick into one impossible pose; this image intentionally shows only the kick.
